method.visual: The canonical original and every accepted workspace PNG were inspected directly with view_image at native dimensions. Frame, leaf, groove band, diagonal start, hardware, crop, finish separation and forbidden visible content were checked.
method.grooveCount: A read-only luminance scan across the source decorative band identified five distinct groove minima. Every accepted PNG was then visually checked for the same five-groove band.
method.aspectRatio: The original WebP dimensions and every PNG IHDR were read from their byte streams. Accepted outputs were required to stay within 1.0 percent of the source width/height ratio.
method.technical: PNG signature/IHDR, SHA-256, byte size and caBX C2PA/JUMBF presence were read without modifying pixels. Every workspace copy was compared byte-for-byte with its ImageGen artifact.
method.sourceIntegrity: The SHA-256 of original.webp was recorded before and after all calls, and git reported no diff or status entry for that path.

promptAuditNote: The negro attempt-1 prompt mistakenly stated four grooves. The generated raw output independently reproduced the canonical source's five grooves and passed native visual QA. All subsequent prompts correctly specified five.
